text: In closed-loop (autonomous) forecasting, the mode this chapter uses to measure Valid Prediction Time, how is the ESN driven after training?
choices: The network's own predicted state is fed back in as the next input, so it evolves as an autonomous dynamical system
The true Lorenz state is supplied as the input at every step, so teacher forcing continues indefinitely
The recurrent weights W_rec are re-solved by ridge regression at each new step
The reservoir state is reset to zero before every prediction step
explanation: Closed-loop evaluation feeds the reservoir's own output back as the next input (u_hat_t = W_out x_{t-1}), turning the trained ESN into a fully autonomous system, which is why forecasts eventually diverge and VPT is finite. Option 1 describes open-loop / teacher forcing; W_rec is never trained (option 2); the reservoir carries its state forward and is not reset (option 3).
